units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: You've made me wait an awfully long time, Professor.
units.displayText: You've made me wait an awfully long time, Professor.

spans.text: You've made me wait an awfully long time, Professor.

units.rawText: Such opportunities do not come by often. Of course, I would take all the necessary measures. From the looks of it... you've done no lack of preparation yourself.
units.displayText: Such opportunities do not come by often. Of course, I would take all the necessary measures. From the looks of it... you've done no lack of preparation yourself.

spans.text: Such opportunities do not come by often. Of course, I would take all the necessary measures. From the looks of it... you've done no lack of preparation yourself.

units.rawText: The outpost's uppermost level was a vast and open space, yet surrounded in all directions by lurking Entropics. With an amicable smile on her face, Eucharist took her spot opposite me at the table.
units.displayText: The outpost's uppermost level was a vast and open space, yet surrounded in all directions by lurking Entropics. With an amicable smile on her face, Eucharist took her spot opposite me at the table.

spans.text: The outpost's uppermost level was a vast and open space, yet surrounded in all directions by lurking Entropics. With an amicable smile on her face, Eucharist took her spot opposite me at the table.

units.rawText: Relax, they won't interrupt our game unless if you go off and do something untoward—like maybe sending a message to the outside.
units.displayText: Relax, they won't interrupt our game unless if you go off and do something untoward—like maybe sending a message to the outside.

spans.text: Relax, they won't interrupt our game unless if you go off and do something untoward—like maybe sending a message to the outside.

units.rawText: One must pay attention to the game at hand. You understand, yes?
units.displayText: One must pay attention to the game at hand. You understand, yes?

spans.text: One must pay attention to the game at hand. You understand, yes?

units.rawText: Though I must say, for a one-on-one matchup, you seem to have brought a little dog with you. Why might that be?
units.displayText: Though I must say, for a one-on-one matchup, you seem to have brought a little dog with you. Why might that be?

spans.text: Though I must say, for a one-on-one matchup, you seem to have brought a little dog with you. Why might that be?

units.rawText: I will not allow you to do as you please, Eucharist. All of your deeds, I shall record and submit to the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: I will not allow you to do as you please, Eucharist. All of your deeds, I shall record and submit to the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: I will not allow you to do as you please, Eucharist. All of your deeds, I shall record and submit to the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: Wow, so aggressive—will I have to ask you to leave?
units.displayText: Wow, so aggressive—will I have to ask you to leave?

spans.text: Wow, so aggressive—will I have to ask you to leave?

units.rawText: I must ensure my personal safety as a prerequisite of this "game". And with Faith here, she won't be able to assist at the frontline. Is that not an upside for you?
units.displayText: I must ensure my personal safety as a prerequisite of this "game". And with Faith here, she won't be able to assist at the frontline. Is that not an upside for you?

spans.text: I must ensure my personal safety as a prerequisite of this "game". And with Faith here, she won't be able to assist at the frontline. Is that not an upside for you?

units.rawText: Hehe, I'm just reminding you of where you sit exactly. I think that should be enough idle chatter. I've waited so long, I'm already starving.
units.displayText: Hehe, I'm just reminding you of where you sit exactly. I think that should be enough idle chatter. I've waited so long, I'm already starving.

spans.text: Hehe, I'm just reminding you of where you sit exactly. I think that should be enough idle chatter. I've waited so long, I'm already starving.

units.rawText: Watching as I sit down, Eucharist taps at the table.
units.displayText: Watching as I sit down, Eucharist taps at the table.

spans.text: Watching as I sit down, Eucharist taps at the table.

units.rawText: Get ready.
units.displayText: Get ready.

spans.text: Get ready.

units.rawText: Ticktickticktick—
units.displayText: Ticktickticktick—

spans.text: Ticktickticktick—

units.rawText: The game clock on the table suddenly begins to turn with blazing speed.
units.displayText: The game clock on the table suddenly begins to turn with blazing speed.

spans.text: The game clock on the table suddenly begins to turn with blazing speed.

units.rawText: As time flows by at an accelerated pace, the warriors on the board begin to clash. Light and shadow shift as white and black pieces fall around us. Familiar faces and shapes flash by as if the battlefield was upon us once more.
units.displayText: As time flows by at an accelerated pace, the warriors on the board begin to clash. Light and shadow shift as white and black pieces fall around us. Familiar faces and shapes flash by as if the battlefield was upon us once more.

spans.text: As time flows by at an accelerated pace, the warriors on the board begin to clash. Light and shadow shift as white and black pieces fall around us. Familiar faces and shapes flash by as if the battlefield was upon us once more.

units.rawText: Eucharist's smiling countenance grows fuzzy as the battleground's smog fills the space.
units.displayText: Eucharist's smiling countenance grows fuzzy as the battleground's smog fills the space.

spans.text: Eucharist's smiling countenance grows fuzzy as the battleground's smog fills the space.

units.rawText: ...So you'd throw me into an endgame.
units.displayText: ...So you'd throw me into an endgame.

spans.text: ...So you'd throw me into an endgame.

units.rawText: You've just made the first move yourself, Professor. How could it be an endgame? We're merely continuing our previous contest.
units.displayText: You've just made the first move yourself, Professor. How could it be an endgame? We're merely continuing our previous contest.

spans.text: You've just made the first move yourself, Professor. How could it be an endgame? We're merely continuing our previous contest.

units.rawText: I'm excited to see how you'll find a solution here. I wonder... will these pieces move as you desire, Professor?
units.displayText: I'm excited to see how you'll find a solution here. I wonder... will these pieces move as you desire, Professor?

spans.text: I'm excited to see how you'll find a solution here. I wonder... will these pieces move as you desire, Professor?

units.rawText: Tick, tock...
units.displayText: Tick, tock...

spans.text: Tick, tock...

units.rawText: The game clock gradually slows down until it synchronizes fully with the current time.
units.displayText: The game clock gradually slows down until it synchronizes fully with the current time.

spans.text: The game clock gradually slows down until it synchronizes fully with the current time.

units.rawText: Our surroundings' trek through time slows down as the smoke dissipates, and I soon find myself on a great and vast chessboard with Eucharist.
units.displayText: Our surroundings' trek through time slows down as the smoke dissipates, and I soon find myself on a great and vast chessboard with Eucharist.

spans.text: Our surroundings' trek through time slows down as the smoke dissipates, and I soon find myself on a great and vast chessboard with Eucharist.

units.rawText: Let me think about my next move...
units.displayText: Let me think about my next move...

spans.text: Let me think about my next move...

units.rawText: Well, seeing as you've elected to accept my invitation, Professor, I'll have you accept a gift—as a show of good faith.
units.displayText: Well, seeing as you've elected to accept my invitation, Professor, I'll have you accept a gift—as a show of good faith.

spans.text: Well, seeing as you've elected to accept my invitation, Professor, I'll have you accept a gift—as a show of good faith.

units.rawText: Eucharist picks up a black knight, placing it in a position easily capturable by a white pawn, lightly tapping the game clock afterward.
units.displayText: Eucharist picks up a black knight, placing it in a position easily capturable by a white pawn, lightly tapping the game clock afterward.

spans.text: Eucharist picks up a black knight, placing it in a position easily capturable by a white pawn, lightly tapping the game clock afterward.

units.rawText: The time for white begins to tick down.
units.displayText: The time for white begins to tick down.

spans.text: The time for white begins to tick down.

units.rawText: Your turn, Professor.
units.displayText: Your turn, Professor.
